regulations.title: New U.S. Customs Regulations
regulations.p1: Please note that all passengers traveling from Mexico to the United States with a tourist visa must process their permit on the website "https://i94.cbp.dhs.gov/I94/" before arriving at Laredo, TX. Otherwise they will not be allowed to enter the country.
regulations.p2: Under the same regulations, only 2 wheeled manageable suitcases are allowed, and if bringing a cooler it must have wheels.
regulations.p3: Tickets are non-refundable and not valid for any error processed by the client.
regulations.p4: The regulation is in effect as of 07/01/2019!

wizard.title: Purchase Ticket(s) Wizard
wizard.localSelection: Seat selection is local (no real-time updates).
wizard.instruction1: Select the seat(s) Availables - Available seats are in color white with the number and when you pass the mouse over the seat change the color to yellow that means is available. Seats already taken are in color black.
wizard.instruction2: Enter the name(s) for every seat selected.
wizard.instruction3: If you already have selected a seat and you want to change it, first unselect the seat previously selected and then select the new seat.
